server.name: benchline
server.title: Benchline
server.instructions:
Benchline exposes 82 deterministic tools for PDF, images, JSON and data formats, encoding, hashing, security, networking, SEO, and AI search.
Pick the tool whose name matches the job (for example merge_pdf, format_json, decode_jwt, check_robots_txt). Every tool is read-only and idempotent: the same input gives the same output, and nothing is stored.
Files go in as base64 or as a public https URL. Decoded files are capped at 10 MB and private or local addresses are refused. Binary results come back as base64.
Tools marked openWorld fetch the public URL you pass; the rest only transform their arguments.
No key is needed. Limit: 60 calls per minute per address. A failed call returns the exact field that was wrong.
Docs: https://benchline.fabwaseem.com/ai (every tool), https://benchline.fabwaseem.com/llms.txt (index), and /t/<slug>.md for one tool in Markdown.

results.name: calculate_programmer
results.title: Evaluate a programmer expression
results.description: Evaluate integer expressions with C-like precedence (hex/octal/binary literals, bitwise ops, shifts) and report base conversions plus signed/unsigned interpretations.

results.name: aes_crypt
results.title: Encrypt or decrypt with AES-GCM
results.description: AES-256-GCM encryption with PBKDF2-SHA256 key derivation. Encrypt returns a base64 bundle (salt, IV, ciphertext); decrypt reverses it.

results.name: analyze_har
results.title: Analyze a HAR file
results.description: Parse a HAR (HTTP Archive) capture and summarize it: request counts, status distribution, slowest and largest requests, top hosts, and per-request timings.

results.name: convert_json_to_types
results.title: Convert JSON to type definitions
results.description: Infer types from a JSON document and generate TypeScript interfaces, Zod schemas, Python Pydantic models or dataclasses, and Go structs.

results.name: minify_code
results.title: Minify JavaScript, CSS, or HTML
results.description: Minify source code with Terser (JS), csso (CSS), or a structural HTML pass and report before/after byte counts.

results.name: convert_curl
results.title: Convert a curl command to code
results.description: Parse a curl command and generate equivalent JavaScript fetch, Python requests, Go, PHP, or Rust code.

results.name: execute_graphql
results.title: Execute a GraphQL query
results.description: Send a GraphQL query with optional variables and headers to a public http or https endpoint on port 80 or 443 and return the response data or errors. Local, private, and internal addresses are refused.

results.name: validate_websocket_url
results.title: Validate a WebSocket URL
results.description: Validate and parse a ws:// or wss:// URL into its components, and optionally decode a WebSocket close code.

results.name: generate_resume
results.title: Generate a resume PDF
results.description: Build a resume PDF from profile, experience, education, and skills. A name plus at least one experience, education, or skills entry is required. Choose the clean, modern, or compact template. Returns the A4 PDF as base64.

results.name: generate_invoice
results.title: Generate an invoice or quote PDF
results.description: Build an invoice or quote PDF from company and client details, line items with quantities and rates, a tax rate, and an optional percent or flat discount. All money is computed in integer cents, so there are no float rounding errors. Returns the PDF as base64 plus the total.

results.name: sign_pdf
results.title: Sign a PDF with a PNG signature
results.description: Stamp a PNG signature image onto one or more PDF pages at given positions (fractions of the page, x and y measured from the top-left, width as a fraction of page width). The signature keeps its aspect ratio. Returns the signed PDF as base64.

results.name: resize_social_image
results.title: Resize an image to social media dimensions
results.description: Crop and resize an image to an exact social media preset: instagram-post (1080x1080), instagram-portrait (1080x1350), instagram-story (1080x1920), youtube-thumbnail (1280x720), x-post (1200x675), x-header (1500x500), linkedin-post (1200x627), or facebook-post (1200x630). The cover crop keeps the center subject. Send base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused and the decoded file is capped at 10 MB. Returns the image as base64 PNG.

results.name: trim_audio
results.title: Trim a WAV audio file
results.description: Trim a WAV audio file to a time range with optional fade in and out, returning a 16-bit PCM WAV as base64. Only WAV is accepted; the web UI handles MP3/OGG/M4A.

results.name: convert_currency
results.title: Convert an amount between currencies
results.description: Convert money between ISO 4217 currencies with daily exchange rates. ECB reference rates (via Frankfurter) are used for USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD, CNY, INR, CZK, HUF, ILS, ISK, RON, BRL, MXN, SGD, HKD, NZD, SEK, NOK, DKK, ZAR, TRY, KRW, THB, MYR, IDR, PHP, PLN; other codes such as PKR, AED, SAR or NGN use the free fawazahmed0 currency API. The result says which source answered. Supports historical dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

results.name: generate_meme
results.title: Generate a meme image
results.description: Render a classic top/bottom-caption meme as a PNG. Give it an image (base64, data URI, or public URL) or pick a gradient style, and it returns captioned meme artwork.

results.name: zip_files
results.title: Zip files or unzip an archive
results.description: Create a ZIP archive from files or list and extract the contents of a ZIP archive. Everything is handled in memory; no files are stored.

results.name: make_collage
results.title: Make a photo collage
results.description: Arrange up to 9 photos into a collage layout (duo, trio, focus, quad, six, nine) with a gap and background color, and get back a square PNG.

results.name: fill_pdf_form
results.title: Fill a PDF form
results.description: Fill an interactive PDF form's text fields, checkboxes, dropdowns, and radios by field name, with an option to flatten the result. Pass inspectOnly to list the fields first.
